RM-TRIUNE-001.failure_contract: Malformed or unavailable entity roles must fail deterministically before relation semantics are applied; host reference aliasing is not part of the AVM contract.

CTX-CURRENT-001.failure_contract: Access to a required current-context role must either yield its exact identity/value or fail as an invalid context; it must not synthesize a missing role.

CTX-PARENT-001.failure_contract: Traversal beyond the available parent chain must fail deterministically rather than wrap, clamp or materialize a context.

REF-PRONOUN-001.failure_contract: An unresolved context pronoun/path is a lookup failure; resolution itself must not write to LinkStore.

REF-ABSOLUTE-001.failure_contract: A missing name or path is an observational miss unless an explicit external lookup/write operation is requested separately.

REF-LAZY-DB-001.failure_contract: Provider absence/failure must be reported through the explicit capability boundary and cannot be converted into hidden pure-resolution materialization.

REF-LVALUE-001.failure_contract: Invalid traversal or write target must fail before unintended partial realization; read resolution never inherits create-on-write behavior.

EXEC-ARRAY-SEQ-001.failure_contract: Children execute in defined order; the canonical core sequence is fail-fast unless a frontend compatibility policy explicitly specifies otherwise.

EXEC-OBJECT-PAR-001.failure_contract: No compatibility claim is made until deterministic ordering and conflict/failure semantics for parallel execution are defined.

EXEC-FOREACH-OBJ-001.failure_contract: Child contexts must be created in deterministic collection order and failures must follow the future #127 iteration policy without skipping or duplicating items silently.

EXEC-FOREACH-SUB-001.failure_contract: Child subject contexts must preserve deterministic order and explicit failure propagation; semantics depend on the triune contract of #124.

CTRL-IF-001.failure_contract: Exactly one selected branch executes; invalid condition/value fails deterministically and the unselected branch is never evaluated.

CTRL-WHILE-001.failure_contract: Condition/body failures propagate deterministically; termination/guard policy must be explicit and no hidden host loop state may define semantic identity.

CTRL-SWITCH-001.failure_contract: Branch selection must be deterministic for the canonical key; missing/default behavior must be explicit rather than inherited from JSON object lookup quirks.

ERROR-THROW-CATCH-001.failure_contract: Program-level error values and AVM runtime failures must remain distinguishable from host exceptions; catch scope/context must be deterministic.

VALUE-COPY-001.failure_contract: Copy/view must either produce the defined value/projection or fail without mutating arbitrary host references; exact manifestation semantics are owned by #124.

VALUE-ARITH-001.failure_contract: Invalid numeric operands, overflow/domain behavior and result type must be specified by canonical numeric semantics rather than inherited accidentally from nlohmann::json/C++ conversions.

VALUE-COMPARE-001.failure_contract: Equality/order across unsupported or incomparable denotations must have an explicit deterministic result/error policy; JSON type ordering is not normative.

VALUE-COLLECTION-001.failure_contract: Malformed/non-collection operands fail deterministically; observational collection operations do not materialize missing structure.

VALUE-GETSET-001.failure_contract: Literal JSON container mutation is not an AVM semantic target; required behavior is decomposed into explicit reference resolution and realization contracts.

VALUE-STRING-001.failure_contract: Encoding, invalid operands and operation result semantics must be defined by the canonical text model; JSON string implementation details are not normative.

VALUE-TYPE-PRED-001.failure_contract: The nlohmann::json type universe is intentionally not reproduced; only independently justified AVM structural/value predicates may replace selected behavior.

DISPLAY-PRINT-001.failure_contract: Output failures belong to the explicit host capability/diagnostic boundary and must not masquerade as pure VM value semantics.

DISPLAY-MARKUP-001.failure_contract: Markup generation is frontend/projection behavior; malformed structures must fail according to the future text/projection contract, not mutable JSON traversal.

EFFECT-TIME-001.failure_contract: Clock/sleep availability and failures are capability outcomes; deterministic tests use a fake provider and never depend on wall-clock timing.

EFFECT-FS-001.failure_contract: Filesystem errors are explicit capability results/failures; pure execution and reference lookup cannot touch host files implicitly.

EFFECT-HTTP-001.failure_contract: Network success/failure is an explicit capability outcome; conformance uses deterministic fake providers before real networking is introduced.

EFFECT-DLL-001.failure_contract: Plugin load/symbol failures are host capability failures; dynamic symbol names cannot become canonical relation identity implicitly.

IMPL-JSON-MUTEX-001.failure_contract: JSON mutex placement is not semantic and is dropped; future concurrency rules belong to backend/scheduler contracts.

IMPL-JSON-AST-001.failure_contract: JSON-as-code/data/context is intentionally removed; reintroducing it would create a second semantic universe and is an architectural failure, not a compatibility feature.
